rows.text: Q2 FY27 AUM up 68% YoY (16% QoQ) to Rs 9,317 cr, PAT up 100% YoY (32% QoQ) to Rs 125 cr; separately raised Rs 832.2 cr via a preferential issue after quarter-end, BSE/NSE in-principle approval 19-Oct (per the filing's own headline).

allots 2,64,93,882 equity shares at Rs 314.11 to Alchemy Capital Management (Hiren Ved) and WhiteOak Capital (Prashant Khemka) on a preferential basis, raising Rs 832.20 cr; paid-up capital rises to Rs 20.46 cr
receives NSE/BSE in-principle approval for a preferential issue of 2,64,93,882 shares at Rs 314.11 each, up to Rs 832.20 cr, to non-promoter investors; allotment has not yet happened.
Q2 FY27 AUM grows **68.4% YoY to ~Rs 9,317 crore**, with disbursements of **Rs 4,612 crore** in the quarter, up from Rs 3,812 crore in Q1 FY27.

rows.quant: up to Rs 832.20 cr; ~13.7% of mcap
rows.text: board approves a **preferential issue of up to 2,64,93,882 shares at Rs 314.11 to 34 non-promoter investors, up to Rs 832.20 crore**, for an EGM on 14 October
